title: ATC Communication - Video 1
text: ATC Communication - Video 1 Question: What was the initial problem reported by Delta Flight 1294? Answer: The crew reported a flap issue. Question: What did Delta Flight 1294 do immediately after reporting the flap issue? Answer: They went around and requested extended vectors to run through some checklists. Question: Which airport was Delta Flight 1294 approaching when the issue occurred? Answer: New York John F. Kennedy International Airport (KJFK). Question: What specific request did the crew of Delta Flight 1294 make regarding their landing? Answer: They requested the longest runway for their landing. Question: Did Delta Flight 1294 declare an emergency? Answer: Yes, the crew declared an emergency. Question: What information did air traffic control request from Delta Flight 1294 after declaring an emergency? Answer: ATC asked for the number of souls on board and the fuel remaining. Question: Which runway was Delta Flight 1294 initially directed to for landing? Answer: They were initially directed to expect an ILS approach to Runway 31 right. Question: Was there a change in the runway assignment for Delta Flight 1294? If so, what was it? Answer: Yes, the runway assignment was changed to Runway 31 left. Question: What was the airspeed maintained by Delta Flight 1294 during the approach, and what speed did they consider reducing to? Answer: They maintained 180 knots and considered slowing down to 155 knots if necessary. Question: Did Delta Flight 1294 require any assistance after landing?
